_comment: Academic Studio 'Recommended Plugins' catalog. This is the live file, served at https://academic-studio.com/plugins.json; the app fetches it on startup and in Run Setup, so curating plugins = edit site/plugins.json + push (GitHub Pages deploys site/**). Each entry is declarative data — a git source installed as a Claude skill via `npx skills add`, plus optional pip libs — the app never executes shell text from this file. Keep overlay/builtin-extensions/academic-studio-setup/packages.snapshot.json (the offline fallback bundled into the app) in sync with this.

packages.label: Finance Data — fetch market & economic data (Yahoo Finance, FRED, SEC EDGAR, Ken French, FinnHub, Financial Modeling Prep) and save as CSV
